Some of the small colorful toppings (sprinkles/diced fruit) appear to float slightly or lack clear contact shadows with the crepe surface, giving a minor 'pasted on' look.

The elliptical perspective of the pan rim is generally correct, but the thickness of the rim varies inconsistently along the curve, appearing thicker on the left and thinner on the right without a clear light/shadow reason.
